metadata.question: Does the rainfall in Somalia decrease during March-September 2022 compared to the 1981-2021 average?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in Somalia during March-September 2022 compared to the 1981-2021 average. This requires: 1. Data: I'll use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which is a reliable precipitation dataset 2. Time periods: - Baseline: March-September average for 1981-2021 (41 years) - Comparison: March-September 2022 3. Location: Somalia (I'll use a polygon covering Somalia) 4. Processing: Calculate total rainfall for each period and compare Strategy: - Use CHIRPS daily precipitation data - Define Somalia polygon - Calculate March-September totals for baseline (1981-2021) and 2022 - Compare if 2022 total < baseline average Need to handle: - Check if collections are empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2) - Validate calculations (C3) - Output concise evidence ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Somalia polygon const somalia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[40.98, 11.99], [51.41, 11.99], [51.41, -1.66], [40.98, -1.66], [40.98, 11.99]] ]); // Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // Baseline period: March-September for 1981-2021 const baselineFilter = ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.calendarRange(1981, 2021, 'year'), ee.Filter.calendarRange(3, 9, 'month') ); const baselineCol = chirps.filter(bounds).filter(baselineFilter); // 2022 period: March-September const year2022Filter = ee.Filter.and( ee.Filter.calendarRange(2022, 2022, 'year'), ee.Filter.calendarRange(3, 9, 'month') ); const year2022Col = chirps.filter(bounds).filter(year2022Filter); // Check collection sizes const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); const year2022Size = year2022Col.size().getInfo(); print(`Baseline images (1981-2021 Mar-Sep): ${baselineSize}`); print(`2022 images (Mar-Sep): ${year2022Size}`); if (baselineSize === 0 || year2022Size === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Calculate total precipitation for each period const baselineTotal = baselineCol.sum(); const year2022Total = year2022Col.sum(); // Calculate baseline average per year (divide by 41 years) const baselineAvg = baselineTotal.divide(41); // Reduce regions to get mean precipitation values const baselineStats = baselineAvg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: somalia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const year2022Stats = year2022Total.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: somalia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const baselineVal = baselineStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); const year2022Val = year2022Stats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); print(`Baseline avg (1981-2021): ${baselineVal ? baselineVal.toFixed(1) : 'null'} mm`); print(`2022 total: ${year2022Val ? year2022Val.toFixed(1) : 'null'} mm`); // Check for calculation failures if (baselineVal === null || year2022Val === null || isNaN(baselineVal) || isNaN(year2022Val)) { print("C3"); return; } // Check for valid pixels by counting non-zero pixels const pixelCount = baselineAvg.gt(0).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: somalia, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); print(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // Compare values and determine answer const decreasePercent = ((baselineVal - year2022Val) / baselineVal * 100).toFixed(1); print(`Change: ${decreasePercent}%`); if (year2022Val < baselineVal) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
